scope: Two actual GGUF models compared to five fresh native repetitions at 512 input / 128 output tokens
parameter_policy: Keep declared hardware capacities and analytical efficiency assumptions; correct source operation, dispatch, storage and task ownership facts only.

confirmed_corrections.correction: Qualified ordinary Qwen3 F16 physical matrices with F32 input/output and M=1 use CUDA vector arithmetic, one CTA per output row, the source block-size minimizer and source shared-memory size. They do not use the dense Tensor Core CTA grid.
confirmed_corrections.conditions: RTX5080; source-qualified ordinary Qwen3 GGUF; TP=1; contiguous positive 2D F16 weights with even K; matching exact physical bytes; F32 I/O; default Qwen3 accumulation.
confirmed_corrections.remaining_limits: Registers, achieved scalar/reduction bandwidth and efficiency are analytical assumptions, not native kernel measurements. Source-rule qualification is not an observed native dispatch trace.

confirmed_corrections.correction: Mixed quantization is partitioned at actual GGUF matrices. Qualified F16 Q/K/V and nonfused gate/up matrices also execute as distinct calls in prefill and decode. Exact total weight/output bytes are conserved; each call reads shared activation data with a common physical buffer identity, and output parts have distinct identities. M=1 matching gate/up can use source-supported SwiGLU fusion.
confirmed_corrections.remaining_limits: Default synthetic presets without source-qualified GGUF evidence keep their declared analytical fused-projection policy.

confirmed_corrections.correction: Q width is heads times head dimension, independently of residual hidden size. Qwen3 Q/K per-head RMSNorm now participates in control-plane requirements, runtime operations, mapping validation and fusion boundaries. GGUF uses its actual norm bindings; default Qwen3 presets declare and count two head-dimension norm vectors.
confirmed_corrections.formal_matrix_scope: Q/K norm changes 8 Qwen3 models across 3 hardware presets: 24 of the 63 formal cells. Capacity-rejected cells remain capacity rejections, not successful simulation runs.
confirmed_corrections.remaining_limits: RMSNorm uses the existing analytical reduction/apply and memory model, including its broadcast/cache assumptions; native instruction timing is not calibrated.

confirmed_corrections.source: src/llama-context.cpp host logits copy; common/sampling.cpp ordered sampler chain; this run's native_server_props and request configuration
confirmed_corrections.correction: Declare F32 logits in hostmem0 and the observed CPU top-k/top-p/min-p/temperature/distribution chain. Temperature zero does not remove preceding filters. The existing PCIe/DRAM and supported CPU costs now participate.
confirmed_corrections.remaining_limits: Completion interrupt latency, sampler heap repair/sort/branch/cache/compiler behavior and some disabled-stage/EOS-bias overhead remain explicitly partial. No invented throughput or latency is supplied.

confirmed_corrections.correction: Aggregate task records retain the producing GPU and source-memory identities required to compact D2H stages. The previous omission rejected valid host-output simulations. Retention changes neither resource demand nor event timestamps.

The paired scenarios explicitly select runtime sin/cos. Q and K execute separately, nonexistent precomputed sin/cos table reads are removed, and two sin/cos function evaluations per rotated pair are charged using the existing declared GPU special-function capacity. F32 Q/K input/output and position inputs remain byte-accounted.
confirmed_corrections.remaining_limits: powf frequency generation, other angle arithmetic, YaRN interpolation, compiled instruction expansion and function-specific achieved issue rates remain partial. Counting sin/cos calls is not a measured sin/cos latency. Default presets retain their declared precomputed-table strategy.

confirmed_corrections.area: F32 attention intermediates and physical F16 KV storage
confirmed_corrections.source: ggml/src/ggml-cuda/set-rows.cu (one cast per output element); src/llama-kv-cache.cpp get_n_kv (minimum 256-row padded view)
confirmed_corrections.correction: Qualified paired QKV outputs remain entirely F32 through Q/K norm and separate source RoPE. K and V SET_ROWS explicitly read F32 source tensors/index arrays and write distinct resident F16 caches. K is token-major; V is channel-major with explicit strided columns. QK and PV read those same physical buffers after the stores; no bookkeeping-only cache append is charged as a write. One F32-to-F16 conversion per stored element uses the existing scalar capacity within SET_ROWS; no new launch or fitted rate.
confirmed_corrections.padding: Paired effective capacity is 768: prefill 512 reads 512 cache rows; logical decode context 513 through 639 reads the pinned-source padded 768-row view. Generic/default execution has a distinct unpadded logical-KV contract.
confirmed_corrections.remaining_limits: Conversion-specific issue rate, index generation/upload, native addresses and detailed softmax/gate cache-line selection remain analytical or partial. Source conversion operation count is exact; hardware timing is not measured.

confirmed_corrections.correction: Stages retain original unresolved physical accesses and demands. Their physical service executes on the live persistent event kernel; reports reduce its actual events. Cold planning previews are not reused as final physical timing/traffic. K/V generation zero survives cohort boundaries and ordinary request completion releases its declared cache buffers.
confirmed_corrections.verification: Original DAG versus stage replay tested over prefill and two decodes for a complete tiny generic model and real GGUF attention layers. Both paired UI 512/128 runs have completed with live physical participation; formal matrix status is tracked separately in comparison.json.
confirmed_corrections.remaining_limits: Physical DRAM configuration and preserved history establish execution coverage, not native predictive accuracy.

cost_ownership.physical_memory: Physical DRAM endpoint demand replaces the logical endpoint placeholder. The unchanged device-stream envelope and physical completion participate through max/overlap completion, not a serial physical-plus-aggregate sum.
cost_ownership.remaining_envelope: The analytical device-stream memory lower bound includes CTA saturation and transaction efficiency. It can dominate a physical DRAM model. Physical configuration alone does not guarantee predictive accuracy.
cost_ownership.address_model: Shared source buffers preserve logical identity; native allocator addresses, exact hardware cache conflicts and native dispatch traces are not observed.

comparison_boundary.ttft: Server engine prompt_ms, including first-token sampling; exclude client HTTP/SSE delivery latency.
comparison_boundary.tpot: Server predicted_ms divided by 127 generated intervals for 128 visible tokens.
comparison_boundary.e2e: Server prompt_ms plus predicted_ms; compare to simulation engine begin through final visible token.
comparison_boundary.short_smoke: 16/3 debug runs validate prefill and two consecutive decode contracts; they are never used to calculate native prediction error. Earlier 16/2 metrics are superseded diagnostics.
comparison_boundary.interpretation: Final 512/128 UI-submitted simulation values must be compared separately for TTFT, TPOT and E2E against native median/min/max. Report signed and absolute percentage error even when it is large; a five-run range is not a population confidence interval.

implementation_equivalence: physical_capture_equivalence.json quantifies trace-retention True versus False: byte/energy/counter differences 0; finite float timing differences are reported explicitly and are distinct from native prediction error. dram_batch_equivalence.json separately measures ordered small-request batching versus serial execution: all recorded numeric values and final states match exactly; actual 0.6B full-model 4/3 median wall time improves 79.6345s to 41.3553s (1.9256x), without changing physical parameters or omitting requests. Existing UI runs with the serial executor retain the same measured semantics.

source_rules: ggml/src/ggml-cuda/common.cuh:1291 is_enabled disables graphs when GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS is present (any value).
ggml/src/ggml-cuda/ggml-cuda.cu:4427 requires compatible nodes and two stable graph calls before capture/replay.
cuda_graph_execution_evidence.log_interpretation: Saved graphs reused counters come from llama-context.cpp:1360 GGML graph-construction reuse, not cudaGraphLaunch. Default runs did not record the relevant environment or CUDA graph trace.
cuda_graph_execution_evidence.simulation: Both actual paired submissions have kernel_model.graph_enabled=false and graph_launch_ns=null, with no per-node captured graph binding. Explicit replay launch coalescing does not participate.
cuda_graph_execution_evidence.controlled_remeasurement: Completed for both models: same binary/models/512 input/128 output/context 768/2 warmups/5 formal samples; GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1 was passed in each llama-server child environment and recorded. Original default measurements remain native_default_config_<slug>.json.
cuda_graph_execution_evidence.interpretation: Default native CUDA graph use cannot be asserted from defaults, and no measured error is attributed to this single factor.

controlled_observation_limits.actual_gpu_layer_count: Formal timing runs did not retain layer-count logs because verbosity=3 filtered them. Separate same-config verbosity=5 diagnostics confirm all main layers and output assigned CUDA0, with only expected CPU input embedding buffer; see native_placement_evidence. This does not create retroactive per-process VRAM observations of formal runs.
controlled_observation_limits.native_peak_vram: not measured; nvidia-smi records only baseline and after each server exited, not inference peak.
controlled_observation_limits.native_oom_status: Both runs completed with five valid formal samples; retained logs contain no OOM or failed-load messages. This does not independently establish the actual offload-layer count.
controlled_observation_limits.load_context: CPU baseline 6.1%; GPU baseline 14% utilization and 3455 MiB allocated. Display/browser GPU use was present; no competing llama-server/llama-cli process existed. Twenty identified simulation/diagnostic workers were paused and restored.
controlled_observation_limits.timing_variation: Five observed samples show visible spread; preserve all median/min/max values. The observed range is not a confidence interval, and the difference from old default runs cannot be attributed quantitatively to CUDA Graph alone.

native_placement_evidence.log_filtering: Both formal samples report verbosity=3. common/log.cpp:479-497 maps LLAMA_LOG_INFO to TRACE=4 and filters it; accepted ordinary INFO writes stderr (common/log.cpp:94-108). The offload/buffer messages were suppressed, not lost to stdout.
native_placement_evidence.requested_placement: common/arg.cpp:2785 accepts -1 as auto; --fit off skips common_fit_params (common/common.cpp:1295-1329). common_model_params_to_llama preserves n_gpu_layers; src/llama-model.cpp:1897-1899 interprets negative layers as n_layer_all+1. Layer assignment is GPU-first while input embedding is explicitly CPU (1494-1519).
native_placement_evidence.compatibility_fallback: src/llama-model.cpp:1448-1453 appends CPU candidates to GPU lists. model-loader.cpp:1060-1070/1256 chooses the first backend-compatible buffer; the change message is DEBUG level (1396-1400). Fit off alone does not disable this behavior.
native_placement_evidence.allocation_failure: src/llama-model.cpp:1765/1781 throws on buffer allocation failure. common/common.cpp:1329-1332 returns on a null model; no OOM-driven layer-reduction retry is present on this path.
native_placement_evidence.separate_diagnostic_scope: Verbose diagnostic instances used the same binary/model/memory/graph/request settings, changed only port and verbosity. They supply placement evidence, not additional latency samples or retroactive per-process observation of formal measurements.

diagnostics.interpretation: 28 main layers plus output assigned CUDA0; native reports 29/29. All 28 KV layers use CUDA0. Only token_embd.weight changes CUDA_Host to CPU (and 0 others), matching the fixed CPU input/mmap path. INFO repeating-layer count is not used because the pinned logger subtracts one; DEBUG assignments are authoritative.
